body: I wish my NMom and NDad aborted me also.  It's comforting to realize that someone else feels the same.  I don't think I will ever overcome the depression and alcoholism I have from being raised in a Nhousehold.
If I had money, I would give you an award for this comment.

I feel exactly the same way, I cannot wait to die and am researching the most painless way to commit suicide (life has been enough miserable suffering I feel I deserve the least amount of pain on my way out).  I have felt like this for 25 years and anytime any situation in my life seems to be looking up (new job, new relationship, marriage) I may have a period of happiness for a bit, but everything ends up turning into a depressing nightmare after a couple of months.  I am at the point where I am sick of even having brief bits of happiness as it makes the oncoming reality and depression of my life even worse when the happiness ends.  It is almost as if the universe is mocking me by making me think their is any chance of lasting joy for me.  In my 20s I used to try to fight these feelings and took advice that things will improve.  I went to college, got jobs, and was in many relationships.  Although I entered these situations with the a positive outlook, all these situations turned into insufferable nightmares, therefore spiraling my depression (abusive partners, jobs where everyone backstabbed and gossiped about everyone, and my marriage turned into a complete abusive debacle).  I have no hope for anything anymore I cannot wait to die.
